module: Global filter (runningOrder 0.2) that softens camera changes: stores the previous frame's pose (position relative to the vehicle, rotation, FOV, nearClip) and, when start() is called, blends the new camera with the old one over the configured duration (settings cameraTransitionTime, 300 ms by default, and cameraVehicleTransitionTime, 500 ms for a vehicle change). The blend is quadratic (perc^2) with nlerp of the rotation. No blend if the two points cannot see each other or are more than 100 m apart (for simple camera changes). Returns a constructor.
notes: Also used for camera path transitions: if camPathTransitionData is provided, its callback receives a copy of data.res and the camera takes back the old pose.
A request received before the first recorded frame waits until a pose exists (camLastPosAbs different from infinity).
The extracted page says start(camPathTransitionData, duration) but the code is start(isVehicleSwitch, camPathTransitionData, duration); canTransition(origin, target) has two parameters.

init.desc: isGlobal, isFilter, hidden, runningOrder 0.2, initial state and settings reading.

canTransition.desc: Says whether the blend is allowed between two points: always for a "camera"-type request (false), otherwise only if distance <= 100 m and mutual visibility (static rays).

start.desc: Requests a blend from the last pose; it starts on the next frame.

isVehicleSwitch.desc: true for a vehicle change (vehicle duration, visibility test)

duration.desc: duration in seconds that replaces the configured duration for this transition

update.desc: Records the pose or applies the blend to data.res.
